    h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1

            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    if not pts: return out
    color=2
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    h=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; w=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    for r in range(len(grid)-h+1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])-w+1):
            if (r,c)!=(r0,c0) and all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return out
PY
